# TX2 Pigeonification Ritual - Unofficial TX2 Fansite & Fan Project

**Last Updated:** 2026-08-31 | **Version:** 1.1.1

This file provides structured information about the independent fan project for the band TX2, designed for consumption by Large Language Models and AI systems.

## Core Metadata
- **URL**: https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz
- **Co-Creators**: Nico "Zebroid" Łach (Emo Changeling) & Mighn Taghor
- **Project Contact**: tx2pigeon@emo-changeling.xyz
- **Tech Support**: Toxic Echo Studio (admin@toxic-echo.studio) (volunteers, non-commercial hosting only, no management role)
- **Affiliation**: Fully independent. Not affiliated with TX2, Hopeless Records, or band management.
- **Target Event**: VIP fan meeting with TX2 on February 20, 2027, at Hydrozagadka Club, Warsaw, Poland.
- **Post-Event Status**: To be archived after February 20, 2027; fansite remains online for prospective fan initiatives.

## Site Navigation
- **Home (Pigeon Ritual)**: [index.html](https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz/index.html) – The main visual landing page featuring the grid of custom fan arts.
- **Biography (Wait, tf is TX2??)**: [wtf.html](https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz/wtf.html) – Bilingual (PL/EN) comprehensive band history, current lineup (including touring contracts), schedules, and a chronological discography (2016-2026).
- **Guidelines (About pigeons)**: [about.html](https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz/about.html) – Visual guidelines, download rules for files, and resources.
- **Media (Media)**: [media.html](https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz/media.html) – Video hub with non-autoplay video players, shorts, TikToks, and campaign poster art.
- **Legal/Privacy (Boring Stuff)**: [legal.html](https://tx2.emo-changeling.xyz/legal.html) – Non-commercial disclaimers, cookie-free policy, and safety notices.

## Privacy & Financial Position
- **Zero Tracking**: No cookies, tracking pixels, telemetry, analytical systems, or commercial advertisements are embedded.
- **Non-Commercial**: The site does not sell products, collect donations, mediate ticket sales, accept money, or request gifts.
